categories.name: Farmer & Agriculture
categories.description: Financial support, crop insurance, credit cards, and farming equipment subsidies.
categories.description_hi: वित्तीय सहायता, फसल बीमा, क्रेडिट कार्ड और कृषि उपकरण सब्सिडी।

categories.name: Education & Student
categories.description: Scholarships, college admissions, exam notifications, and student loan schemes.
categories.description_hi: छात्रवृत्ति, कॉलेज प्रवेश, परीक्षा अधिसूचनाएं और छात्र ऋण योजनाएं।

categories.name: Health & Family
categories.description: Cashless healthcare, health insurance, vaccination, and maternal health benefits.
categories.description_hi: कैशलेस स्वास्थ्य सेवा, स्वास्थ्य बीमा, टीकाकरण और मातृ स्वास्थ्य लाभ।

categories.name: Employment & Business
categories.description: Job portals, skill training, MSME loans, subsidies, and business registrations.
categories.description_hi: रोजगार पोर्टल, कौशल प्रशिक्षण, एमएसएमई ऋण, सब्सिडी और व्यवसाय पंजीकरण।

categories.name: Housing & Urban
categories.description: Affordable housing subsidies, ration card, property registration, and urban amenities.
categories.description_hi: किफायती आवास सब्सिडी, राशन कार्ड, संपत्ति पंजीकरण और नागरिक सुविधाएं।

categories.name: Identity & Certificates
categories.description: Aadhaar, PAN card, voter ID, caste/income certificates, birth & death records.
categories.description_hi: आधार, पैन कार्ड, वोटर आईडी, जाति/आय प्रमाण पत्र, जन्म व मृत्यु रिकॉर्ड।

categories.name: Transport & Vehicles
categories.description: Driving licenses, vehicle RC registration, RTO services, and PUC certificates.
categories.description_hi: ड्राइविंग लाइसेंस, वाहन आरसी पंजीकरण, आरटीओ सेवाएं और पीयूसी प्रमाण पत्र।

categories.name: Social Welfare
categories.description: Old age pension, disability certificates, widow assistance, and child protection.
categories.description_hi: वृद्धावस्था पेंशन, दिव्यांग प्रमाण पत्र, विधवा सहायता और बाल सुरक्षा योजनाएं।

categories.name: Legal & Citizen Services
categories.description: Police clearance, e-FIR, RTI online requests, free legal aid, and passport seva.
categories.description_hi: पुलिस सत्यापन, ई-एफआईआर, आरटीआई ऑनलाइन, मुफ्त कानूनी सहायता और पासपोर्ट सेवा।

categories.name: Others & Utilities
categories.description: Electricity connections, piped drinking water, municipal tax, and grievance redressal.
categories.description_hi: बिजली कनेक्शन, नल जल योजना, नगर पालिका कर और लोक शिकायत निवारण।

services.title: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
services.benefits: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year transferred in 3 equal four-monthly installments into bank accounts.
services.benefits_hi: बैंक खातों में 3 समान किस्तों में प्रति वर्ष ₹6,000 की प्रत्यक्ष आय सहायता।
services.description: PM-KISAN is a central sector scheme to augment income of small and marginal landholding farmer families across the country for procurement of agricultural inputs.
services.description_hi: पीएम-किसान योजना देश भर के छोटे और सीमांत किसान परिवारों को कृषि आदानों की खरीद के लिए आय सहायता प्रदान करती है।

guidance_steps.title: Self Registration
guidance_steps.description: Visit the PM-KISAN official portal or nearest CSC Kendra and click 'New Farmer Registration'.

guidance_steps.title: Aadhaar Authentication
guidance_steps.description: Enter your 12-digit Aadhaar number and captcha, then enter the OTP received on registered mobile.

guidance_steps.title: Fill Land & Bank Details
guidance_steps.description: Provide state, district, sub-district, block, village, land survey/khata number, and IFSC bank details.

guidance_steps.title: Verification by State Nodal Officer
guidance_steps.description: Your application is routed to the district agriculture office / revenue officer for physical land record matching.

guidance_steps.title: Installment Credit
guidance_steps.description: Upon approval, your farmer registration number is generated and installment is credited via DBT.

faqs.q: Is eKYC mandatory for existing farmers?
faqs.a: Yes, OTP based eKYC is available on PMKISAN Portal or biometric eKYC at CSC centers.

faqs.q: Can non-landholding tenant farmers apply?
faqs.a: No, currently the scheme requires registered cultivable land in the applicant's name.

services.title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
services.benefits: Comprehensive risk insurance covering post-harvest losses, localized natural calamities, drought, floods, and pest attacks at lowest premium (1.5% - 2%).
services.benefits_hi: न्यूनतम प्रीमियम (1.5% - 2%) पर सूखा, बाढ़, कीट हमले और फसल कटाई के बाद के नुकसान के लिए व्यापक बीमा।
services.description: PMFBY provides financial support to farmers suffering crop loss/damage arising out of unforeseen events, stabilizing farmer income and encouraging modern practices.
services.description_hi: अप्रत्याशित प्राकृतिक आपदाओं से फसल नुकसान की भरपाई और किसानों की आय स्थिर करने के लिए बीमा योजना।

guidance_steps.title: Check Cut-off Date
guidance_steps.description: Ensure crop insurance is purchased before the Kharif/Rabi cut-off date announced by state.

guidance_steps.title: Apply Online or Bank/CSC
guidance_steps.description: Fill crop acreage details and upload sowing certificate.

guidance_steps.title: Pay Farmer Share of Premium
guidance_steps.description: Pay 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, or 5% for annual horticultural crops.

guidance_steps.title: Claim Settlement
guidance_steps.description: In case of damage, notify within 72 hours via the Crop Insurance App or toll-free number.

faqs.q: Within how many hours must loss be reported?
faqs.a: Individual localized damage must be reported within 72 hours of the calamity.

services.title: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
services.benefits: Concessional institutional credit up to ₹3 Lakhs at 4% effective interest rate with prompt repayment incentive for crop production, dairy, and fisheries.
services.benefits_hi: फसल उत्पादन, डेयरी और मत्स्य पालन के लिए 4% प्रभावी ब्याज दर पर ₹3 लाख तक का रियायती ऋण।
services.fee: Zero processing fee for loans up to ₹3 Lakhs
services.description: KCC meets the credit requirements for cultivation, post-harvest expenses, produce marketing loan, consumption requirements of farmer household, and working capital for maintenance of farm assets.
services.description_hi: खेती की लागत, फसल कटाई के बाद के खर्च और पशुपालन हेतु रियायती ऋण योजना।

guidance_steps.title: Form Submission
guidance_steps.description: Download standard one-page KCC application or apply at bank branch / CSC.

guidance_steps.title: Document Verification
guidance_steps.description: Bank verifies land records or animal husbandry proof.

guidance_steps.title: Card Issue
guidance_steps.description: Credit limit sanctioned and RuPay KCC card dispatched.

faqs.q: Is collateral required up to 1.6 Lakhs?
faqs.a: No, collateral free loan limit is ₹1.60 Lakhs, extendable to ₹3 Lakhs for tie-up arrangements.

services.title: National Scholarship Portal (NSP - Pre & Post Matric)
services.title_hi: राष्ट्रीय छात्रवृत्ति पोर्टल (प्री और पोस्ट मैट्रिक)
services.department: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology / Social Justice
services.benefits: Direct bank transfer of school/college tuition fees, monthly maintenance allowance up to ₹25,000/year for meritorious and needy students.
services.benefits_hi: मेधावी और जरूरतमंद छात्रों के लिए ₹25,000/वर्ष तक ट्यूशन फीस और रखरखाव भत्ता।
services.description: Single window portal for Central and State government scholarships across primary to postgraduate education with automated biometric/e-KYC verification.
services.description_hi: कक्षा 1 से उच्च शिक्षा तक विभिन्न छात्रवृत्तियों के लिए राष्ट्रीय एकीकृत पोर्टल।

guidance_steps.title: One-Time Registration (OTR)
guidance_steps.description: Register on NSP using student's Aadhaar and mobile number to receive permanent OTR ID.

guidance_steps.title: Select Eligible Scheme
guidance_steps.description: System auto-suggests scholarships matching student's category, state, and course.

guidance_steps.title: Institute Verification (Level 1)
guidance_steps.description: Nodal officer at school/college verifies admission bonafide and fee details.

guidance_steps.title: District & State Approval (Level 2)
guidance_steps.description: District welfare officer approves the merit roster.

guidance_steps.title: DBT Disbursement via PFMS
guidance_steps.description: Amount is credited directly into student's Aadhaar-seeded bank account.

faqs.q: Can I apply for more than one scholarship on NSP?
faqs.a: You can apply for multiple eligible schemes, but can only accept one central scholarship disbursement per academic year.

services.title: PM Vidya Lakshmi Education Loan Portal
services.title_hi: पीएम विद्या लक्ष्मी शिक्षा ऋण पोर्टल
services.department: Ministry of Education / Department of Financial Services
services.benefits: Apply to multiple scheduled banks with a single common educational loan application form (CELAF); interest subsidy under CSIS for incomes under ₹4.5 LPA.
services.benefits_hi: एकल आवेदन पत्र से कई बैंकों में शिक्षा ऋण के लिए आवेदन, ब्याज सब्सिडी का लाभ।
services.description: Vidya Lakshmi is a first-of-its-kind portal for students seeking education loan, providing information and application status across 40+ banks.
services.description_hi: भारत और विदेश में उच्च शिक्षा हेतु रियायती दरों पर शिक्षा ऋण प्राप्त करने का पोर्टल।

guidance_steps.title: Register on Portal
guidance_steps.description: Create student login and fill Common Educational Loan Application Form (CELAF).

guidance_steps.title: Search & Choose Schemes
guidance_steps.description: Compare interest rates and loan criteria across banks.

guidance_steps.title: Track In-Portal
guidance_steps.description: Monitor loan status and sanction letter directly in dashboard.

faqs.q: Is collateral required for loans up to ₹7.5 Lakhs?
faqs.a: Under the Credit Guarantee Fund Scheme, loans up to ₹7.5 Lakhs generally do not require third-party collateral.

services.title: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY (Golden Card)
services.title_hi: आयुष्मान भारत - प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना
services.benefits: Free secondary and tertiary hospitalization coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year across 28,000+ empaneled public & private hospitals.
services.benefits_hi: सूचीबद्ध अस्पतालों में प्रति वर्ष प्रति परिवार ₹5,00,000 तक मुफ्त इलाज व कैशलेस स्वास्थ्य कवरेज।
services.description: World's largest government-funded healthcare assurance scheme providing cashless and paperless access to services for the beneficiary at the point of care.
services.description_hi: गरीब और कमजोर परिवारों के लिए दुनिया की सबसे बड़ी स्वास्थ्य बीमा योजना।

guidance_steps.title: Check Family Name
guidance_steps.description: Visit beneficiary.nha.gov.in and search by Aadhaar or Ration Card number.

guidance_steps.title: Complete eKYC
guidance_steps.description: Submit Aadhaar OTP or visit nearest Ayushman Mitra at any district hospital.

guidance_steps.title: Download Ayushman Card
guidance_steps.description: Once approved, download the plastic Golden PVC card or digital PDF immediately.

guidance_steps.title: Avail Hospitalization
guidance_steps.description: Show card at the Ayushman Helpdesk in any empaneled hospital for 100% cashless admission.

faqs.q: Is there any cap on family size or age?
faqs.a: No, there is no restriction on family size, age, or gender.

faqs.q: Are pre-existing conditions covered?
faqs.a: Yes, all pre-existing conditions are covered from day one of card activation.

services.title: ABHA Health Account & Digital Card
services.title_hi: आभा (आयुष्मान भारत स्वास्थ्य खाता) डिजिटल कार्ड
services.benefits: Unique 14-digit digital health ID to store and share medical records, lab reports, prescriptions securely across clinics and hospitals across India.
services.benefits_hi: 14-अंकों का डिजिटल स्वास्थ्य पहचान पत्र, मेडिकल रिकॉर्ड और पर्चियों को सुरक्षित सहेजने के लिए।
services.description: Ayushman Bharat Health Account (ABHA) is the foundation of India's digital health ecosystem, ensuring seamless consent-based health record sharing.
services.description_hi: कागज रहित स्वास्थ्य रिकॉर्ड और डिजिटल ओपीडी टोकन हेतु भारत सरकार का डिजिटल स्वास्थ्य खाता।

guidance_steps.title: Enter Aadhaar Number
guidance_steps.description: Type 12-digit Aadhaar on the ABHA portal or mobile app.

guidance_steps.title: Validate OTP
guidance_steps.description: Enter 6-digit OTP received from UIDAI.

guidance_steps.title: Download ABHA Card
guidance_steps.description: Receive instant 14-digit ABHA ID card with QR code.

faqs.q: Can I delete or deactivate my ABHA number?
faqs.a: Yes, users have full control to permanently delete or temporarily deactivate their ABHA.

services.title: PMEGP (Prime Minister Employment Generation Programme)
services.benefits: Credit-linked government subsidy from 15% up to 35% on project costs up to ₹50 Lakhs for manufacturing and ₹20 Lakhs for service units.
services.benefits_hi: विनिर्माण और सेवा इकाइयों के लिए परियोजना लागत पर 15% से 35% तक सरकारी सब्सिडी।
services.description: Major credit-linked subsidy scheme aimed at generating self-employment micro-enterprises in non-farm sectors across rural and urban India.
services.description_hi: नए सूक्ष्म उद्यमों की स्थापना और युवाओं को स्वरोजगार प्रदान करने के लिए प्रमुख योजना।

guidance_steps.title: Online Application
guidance_steps.description: Select agency (KVIC/KVIB/DIC) and fill personal and enterprise details on PMEGP e-portal.

guidance_steps.title: Upload Project Proposal
guidance_steps.description: Submit detailed project cost including equipment, machinery, and working capital.

guidance_steps.title: District Level Task Force Committee (DLTFC)
guidance_steps.description: Application is scrutinized and forwarded to your selected financing bank branch.

guidance_steps.title: Bank Sanction & EDP Training
guidance_steps.description: Complete mandatory Entrepreneurship Development Programme (EDP) training.

guidance_steps.title: Margin Money Subsidy Lock-in
guidance_steps.description: Subsidy is credited into a separate TDR account for 3 years, then adjusted against loan principal.

faqs.q: Is existing business eligible for expansion under initial PMEGP?
faqs.a: Only new projects are eligible for first loan. 2nd financial assistance is available for upgrading existing performing units.

services.title: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
services.benefits: Collateral-free business loans in 3 tiers: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50,000 to ₹5 Lakhs), and Tarun (up to ₹20 Lakhs) with Mudra Card.
services.benefits_hi: शिशु, किशोर और तरुण श्रेणियों में ₹20 लाख तक का बिना गारंटी का व्यावसायिक ऋण।
services.fee: Nil for Shishu and nominal for others
services.description: PMMY provides loans to non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprises to facilitate business growth and financial inclusion.
services.description_hi: दुकानदारों, व्यापारियों और छोटे उद्योगों को बिना किसी गिरवी के आसान ऋण।

guidance_steps.title: Choose Loan Category
guidance_steps.description: Determine capital requirement: Shishu (≤50K), Kishore (≤5L), or Tarun (≤20L).

guidance_steps.title: Apply via Udyamimitra
guidance_steps.description: Apply online at udyamimitra.in or submit directly to any public/private bank or NBFC.

guidance_steps.title: Disbursement
guidance_steps.description: Receive sanctioned loan amount and Mudra Debit Card for working capital.

faqs.q: Can I use Mudra loan for buying personal car?
faqs.a: No, Mudra loans are strictly meant for commercial business purposes and equipment.

services.title: Udyam MSME Registration Certificate
services.department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
services.benefits: Free, permanent digital registration certificate with lifetime validity; qualifies for priority sector lending, tariff subsidies, and govt tender fee exemptions.
services.benefits_hi: सरकारी निविदाओं में छूट, कम ब्याज पर ऋण और एमएसएमई लाभों के लिए मुफ्त पंजीकरण।
services.fee: 100% Free (Beware of fake private portals charging fees)
services.description: The official zero-cost paperless portal for registering micro, small, and medium businesses in India based on Aadhaar and PAN.
services.description_hi: सूक्ष्म, लघु और मध्यम उद्यमों के लिए भारत सरकार का आधिकारिक निःशुल्क पोर्टल।

guidance_steps.title: Aadhaar Verification
guidance_steps.description: Enter 12-digit Aadhaar number and OTP on udyamregistration.gov.in.

guidance_steps.title: PAN Validation
guidance_steps.description: Provide PAN card details; system automatically fetches ITR/GST data from CBDT.

guidance_steps.title: Enterprise Information
guidance_steps.description: Select National Industry Classification (NIC) code and number of employees.

guidance_steps.title: Download Certificate
guidance_steps.description: Get official Udyam Certificate with QR code.

faqs.q: Is GSTIN mandatory for all businesses?
faqs.a: Exempted for entities not required to obtain GST registration under CGST Act.

services.title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY Urban & Gramin)
services.department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs / MoRD
services.benefits: Direct financial assistance of ₹1.20 Lakhs to ₹2.50 Lakhs for pucca house construction or interest subsidy up to ₹2.67 Lakhs on home loans.
services.benefits_hi: पक्का मकान बनाने हेतु ₹2.5 लाख तक की आर्थिक सहायता और गृह ऋण पर ब्याज सब्सिडी।
services.description: Flagship mission of Govt of India addressing the housing shortage among EWS/LIG and MIG categories by ensuring a pucca house to all eligible urban and rural families.
services.description_hi: सभी बेघर और कच्चे मकानों में रहने वाले परिवारों को पक्का मकान उपलब्ध कराने का राष्ट्रीय मिशन।

exclusions: Families who already own a pucca house anywhere in India

documents.name: Aadhaar Card of all family members

guidance_steps.title: Eligibility Assessment
guidance_steps.description: Verify that no family member owns a pucca house in India.

guidance_steps.title: Online Registration / Gram Sabha
guidance_steps.description: Apply via CSC / ULB urban municipality or rural Awas+ app geo-tagging.

guidance_steps.title: Geo-tagging of Site
guidance_steps.description: Government surveyor visits and photographs existing kutcha home.

guidance_steps.title: Stage-wise Release of Installments
guidance_steps.description: Funds released in 3-4 stages: Foundation, Lintel, Roof, and Completion.

faqs.q: Is female ownership mandatory in PMAY?
faqs.a: Yes, houses under PMAY-U are preferably registered in the name of the female head or joint ownership.

services.title: NFSA Digital Ration Card & One Nation One Ration (ONORC)
services.title_hi: डिजिटल राशन कार्ड और एक राष्ट्र एक राशन कार्ड
services.benefits: Monthly subsidized/free food grains (Rice, Wheat, Coarse grains) across any fair price shop in India under ONORC portability.
services.benefits_hi: देश की किसी भी राशन दुकान से मुफ्त या रियायती अनाज प्राप्त करने की पोर्टेबल सुविधा।
services.description: Issue of new priority household (PHH) or Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) digital ration cards with biometric e-PoS lifting across states.
services.description_hi: राशन कार्ड के लिए नया आवेदन, सदस्य जोड़ना और देश भर में कहीं भी राशन उठाना।

documents.name: Aadhaar Card of Family Head (Female Head)
Income Certificate issued by Revenue Authority

guidance_steps.title: Select State Portal
guidance_steps.description: Navigate to State Food & Civil Supplies online portal.

guidance_steps.title: Enter Family Members
guidance_steps.description: Add details and Aadhaar numbers of all family dependents.

guidance_steps.title: Field Verification
guidance_steps.description: Supply Inspector conducts field verification of economic criteria.

guidance_steps.title: Collect Digital Ration Card
guidance_steps.description: Download e-Ration card or collect physical card from local FPS.

faqs.q: Can a migrant worker collect rations in another state?
faqs.a: Yes, under ONORC, any beneficiary can authenticate via biometric e-PoS in any state.

services.title: Aadhaar Enrolment & Document Update
services.benefits: Universal 12-digit verifiable biometric identity proof for all Indian residents, essential for banking, SIM, pensions, and passports.
services.benefits_hi: सभी भारतीय नागरिकों के लिए 12 अंकों का डिजिटल पहचान पत्र और बायोमेट्रिक रिकॉर्ड।
services.fee: Free for first time; ₹50 for demographic updates
services.description: Service for new Aadhaar enrolment, free document revalidation (POI/POA), PVC card order, and mobile/address change.
services.description_hi: नया आधार कार्ड, नाम/पता/मोबाइल नंबर अपडेट और पीवीसी आधार कार्ड ऑनलाइन मंगाना।

documents.name: Proof of Date of Birth (Birth certificate/Marksheet)

guidance_steps.title: Book Appointment or Use myAadhaar
guidance_steps.description: Book slot at Aadhaar Seva Kendra for biometric updates or login with OTP for address update.

guidance_steps.title: Biometric & Demographic Capture
guidance_steps.description: Fingerprints, iris scan, and photo taken at center.

guidance_steps.title: URN Tracking
guidance_steps.description: Track application with 14-digit Enrolment ID / Update Request Number (URN).

guidance_steps.title: Download e-Aadhaar
guidance_steps.description: Download password-protected PDF digitally signed by UIDAI.

faqs.q: Is mandatory biometric update required for children at ages 5 and 15?
faqs.a: Yes, mandatory biometric update (MBU) for children at age 5 and 15 is completely free.

services.title: Instant e-PAN & New PAN Card Application
services.title_hi: इंस्टेंट ई-पैन एवं नया पैन कार्ड आवेदन
services.benefits: 10-digit alphanumeric tax identification number allotted instantly in 10 minutes (paperless via Aadhaar eKYC) or physical card dispatched to home address.
services.benefits_hi: आयकर और वित्तीय लेन-देन के लिए 10 मिनट में डिजिटल ई-पैन कार्ड प्राप्त करें।
services.processing_time: 10 Minutes for e-PAN; 7 Days for Physical Card
services.fee: Free for instant e-PAN; ₹107 for physical card dispatch
services.description: Permanent Account Number is mandatory for opening bank accounts, high-value transactions, filing income tax returns, and business incorporation.
services.description_hi: बैंक खाता खोलने और वित्तीय लेन-देन के लिए आवश्यक स्थाई खाता संख्या (PAN)।

documents.name: Aadhaar Card with linked active mobile
Passport size photograph (for manual NSDL route)

guidance_steps.title: Instant e-PAN Option
guidance_steps.description: Go to Income Tax e-filing portal and click 'Instant e-PAN' -> 'Get New e-PAN'.

guidance_steps.title: Enter Aadhaar & Validate OTP
guidance_steps.description: UIDAI details will be displayed for confirmation.

guidance_steps.title: Instant Generation
guidance_steps.description: Download digitally signed PDF PAN card within minutes.

faqs.q: Is e-PAN as valid as physical PAN card?
faqs.a: Yes, digitally signed e-PAN is completely valid under Rule 114 of Income Tax Rules.

services.title: Caste, Income & Domicile Certificates
services.title_hi: जाति, आय एवं निवास प्रमाण पत्र
services.benefits: Officially certified certificates required for college quota admissions, fee remissions, government jobs reservation, and welfare schemes.
services.benefits_hi: सरकारी नौकरियों, छात्रवृत्ति और प्रवेश में आरक्षण और छूट हेतु आवश्यक सरकारी प्रमाण पत्र।
services.description: Online application via ServicePlus or state e-District portals for SC/ST/OBC/EWS caste certificates, family annual income certificates, and resident domicile.
services.description_hi: राज्य ई-डिस्ट्रिक्ट पोर्टल के माध्यम से आय, जाति और मूल निवास प्रमाण पत्र बनवाएं।

documents.name: Father's Caste Proof / Land Record (for caste)
Salary Slip / Patwari Income Report (for income)

guidance_steps.title: Register on State e-District Portal
guidance_steps.description: Create citizen account on your state's digital seva portal.

guidance_steps.title: Upload Scanned Supporting Docs
guidance_steps.description: Attach photo, affidavit, and revenue documents.

guidance_steps.title: Tehsildar Inquiry & Verification
guidance_steps.description: Revenue inspector / Lekhpal verifies facts and submits recommendation.

guidance_steps.title: Download Barcoded Certificate
guidance_steps.description: Download digitally signed certificate with verification QR code.

faqs.q: What is the validity of an Income Certificate?
faqs.a: Most state income certificates are valid for 1 to 3 financial years from the date of issue.

services.title: Sarathi Driving License (Learner & Permanent DL)
services.title_hi: सारथी ड्राइविंग लाइसेंस (लर्नर एवं पक्का डीएल)
services.department: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH)
services.benefits: Legal authorization to drive two-wheelers, cars, and transport vehicles on public roads across India; smart card driving license.
services.benefits_hi: देश भर में वैध ड्राइविंग लाइसेंस, ऑनलाइन लर्नर टेस्ट और स्मार्ट कार्ड लाइसेंस।
services.processing_time: Same day for LL; 15 Days for Permanent DL
services.fee: ₹200 for Learner License; ₹700 for Permanent DL test & card
services.description: National Parivahan Sarathi platform for faceless contact-less Learner License test from home and appointment booking for permanent driving driving track test.
services.description_hi: घर बैठे ऑनलाइन लर्नर लाइसेंस टेस्ट दें और आरटीओ में स्थायी लाइसेंस का स्लॉट बुक करें।

documents.name: Proof of Age (Birth cert / 10th marksheet / PAN)
Proof of Address (Aadhaar / Passport / Voter ID)

guidance_steps.title: Apply for Learner License (LL)
guidance_steps.description: Fill Form 2 online on Parivahan Sarathi with Aadhaar authentication.

guidance_steps.title: Take Online Audio-Visual Test
guidance_steps.description: Take the 15-question road signs and traffic safety quiz from home web camera.

guidance_steps.title: Download LL
guidance_steps.description: Instant generation of Learner's License valid for 6 months.

guidance_steps.title: Slot Booking for Permanent DL
guidance_steps.description: After 30 days, book driving track test slot at your local RTO.

guidance_steps.title: Pass Track Test & Receive Smart Card
guidance_steps.description: Clear driving test; permanent card delivered via speed post.

faqs.q: How many days after Learner License can I apply for Permanent DL?
faqs.a: You can apply after 30 days and before 180 days (6 months) from LL issue.

services.title: Vahan Vehicle RC Transfer & Renewal
services.department: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
services.benefits: Online ownership transfer (Form 29/30), hypothecation termination, duplicate RC, and fitness certificate renewal without visiting RTO in many states.
services.benefits_hi: गाड़ी की आरसी का नाम बदलना, लोन हटाना और डुप्लीकेट आरसी ऑनलाइन प्राप्त करना।
services.description: Citizen services for motor vehicle registration, change of address, and NOC issuance for inter-state vehicle movement.
services.description_hi: गाड़ियों की आरसी ट्रांसफर, फिटनेस सर्टिफिकेट और एनओसी के लिए ऑनलाइन पोर्टल।

documents.name: Form 29 & Form 30 signed by buyer & seller

guidance_steps.title: Enter Vehicle Number
guidance_steps.description: Login to Parivahan Vahan portal and input Chassis number.

guidance_steps.title: Select Service
guidance_steps.description: Choose 'Transfer of Ownership' or 'Hypothecation Removal'.

guidance_steps.title: Aadhaar e-Sign
guidance_steps.description: Buyer and seller verify via Aadhaar OTP.

guidance_steps.title: Fee Payment & Dispatch
guidance_steps.description: Pay road fee; digital RC updated on mParivahan app.

faqs.q: Is physical inspection required for RC transfer?
faqs.a: In most Aadhaar-authenticated cases within the same RTO jurisdiction, physical inspection is not required.

services.title: National Social Assistance Old Age & Widow Pension (NSAP)
services.title_hi: राष्ट्रीय सामाजिक सहायता वृद्धावस्था एवं विधवा पेंशन
services.benefits: Monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹3,000 (central + state top-up) credited directly into the senior citizen or widow's bank account every month.
services.benefits_hi: वरिष्ठ नागरिकों और विधवाओं के लिए प्रति माह ₹1,000 से ₹3,000 तक की मासिक पेंशन।
services.description: Social security safety net providing financial assistance to destitute senior citizens aged 60+, widows aged 40+, and persons with severe disabilities.
services.description_hi: वृद्धजनों, विधवा महिलाओं और दिव्यांगजनों के लिए सम्मानजनक मासिक आर्थिक सहारा।

documents.name: Death Certificate of Husband (for widow pension)

guidance_steps.title: Application Form
guidance_steps.description: Submit online on state social welfare portal or at Block Development Office / Tehsildar.

guidance_steps.title: Social Audit Verification
guidance_steps.description: Gram Panchayat or Ward member validates living condition.

guidance_steps.title: Sanction Order
guidance_steps.description: District Welfare Officer issues pension sanction PPO number.

guidance_steps.title: Monthly DBT Credit
guidance_steps.description: Monthly pension disbursed through PFMS directly into bank account.

faqs.q: Is annual life certificate (Jeevan Pramaan) required?
faqs.a: Yes, pensioners must submit digital life certificate once a year using face or biometric auth.

services.title: Unique Disability ID (UDID) Card & Swavlamban
services.department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
services.benefits: Single pan-India smart card providing disability concessions in railways, bus travel, education reservation, assistive devices, and pensions.
services.benefits_hi: पूरे भारत में मान्य स्मार्ट कार्ड, रेलवे/बस छूट, उपकरण और आरक्षण के लिए एक पहचान।
services.description: UDID creates a national database for persons with disabilities, issuing a smart card with QR code verified by medical medical boards.
services.description_hi: दिव्यांगजनों के लिए राष्ट्रीय डिजिटल कार्ड और मेडिकल बोर्ड असेसमेंट।

documents.name: Disability Certificate issued by Medical Authority (if already available)

guidance_steps.title: Online Registration
guidance_steps.description: Apply on swavlambancard.gov.in with personal and disability type details.

guidance_steps.title: Hospital Appointment
guidance_steps.description: Slot scheduled at district civil hospital for medical assessment.

guidance_steps.title: Medical Board Evaluation
guidance_steps.description: Doctors calculate disability percentage and sign off digitally.

guidance_steps.title: Plastic Card Dispatch
guidance_steps.description: Card printed and posted to residential address.

faqs.q: Is UDID accepted across all states?
faqs.a: Yes, UDID is recognized uniformly across all Indian states and central departments.

services.title: Passport Seva (Fresh / Re-issue Normal & Tatkaal)
services.department: Consular, Passport and Visa Division (CPV), Ministry of External Affairs
services.benefits: Official government travel document certifying international citizenship and identity; eligible for global travel and visa applications.
services.benefits_hi: अंतरराष्ट्रीय यात्रा और पहचान के लिए भारत सरकार का आधिकारिक पासपोर्ट।
services.fee: ₹1,500 for standard 36-page adult passport; ₹3,500 for Tatkaal
services.description: Passport Seva facilitates simple, transparent, and streamlined delivery of passport services through nationwide Passport Seva Kendras (PSK) and Post Office PSKs.
services.description_hi: पासपोर्ट सेवा केंद्र (पीएसके) के जरिए नया पासपोर्ट और नवीनीकरण की पारदर्शी व्यवस्था।

documents.name: Proof of Date of Birth (Birth cert/Aadhaar/School leaving)
Proof of Present Address (Aadhaar/Bank Passbook/Utility Bill)
Non-ECR proof (10th standard certificate or higher)

guidance_steps.title: Register on Passport Seva Online
guidance_steps.description: Create user account on passportindia.gov.in.

guidance_steps.title: Fill Application Form
guidance_steps.description: Choose Fresh or Re-issue and select 36 or 60 pages.

guidance_steps.title: Pay Online & Book PSK Slot
guidance_steps.description: Schedule appointment at nearest PSK or Post Office PSK (POPSK).

guidance_steps.title: Visit PSK for Biometrics
guidance_steps.description: Counters A (Bio), B (Verification), and C (Granting) process your file.

guidance_steps.title: Police Verification & Speed Post Delivery
guidance_steps.description: Local police station completes verification; passport delivered to doorstep.

faqs.q: Is police verification needed before passport dispatch in Tatkaal?
faqs.a: Under Tatkaal, passport is dispatched on post-police verification basis.

services.title: RTI Online (Right to Information Request)
services.benefits: Enables any citizen to seek information, inspection of records, and certified copies from central government ministries, PSUs, and departments.
services.benefits_hi: सरकारी विभागों से सूचना, रिकॉर्ड और कार्य की जांच प्राप्त करने का नागरिक अधिकार।
services.processing_time: Mandatory 30 Days (48 Hours for Life & Liberty)
services.description: RTI Online is a web portal to file RTI applications and first appeals online for all Central Ministries and public authorities.
services.description_hi: सूचना का अधिकार अधिनियम के तहत ऑनलाइन आवेदन और प्रथम अपील दायर करें।

guidance_steps.title: Select Ministry/Department
guidance_steps.description: Choose the target Public Authority from the dropdown menu.

guidance_steps.title: Draft Specific Questions
guidance_steps.description: Enter precise questions seeking verifiable records and facts.

guidance_steps.title: Pay ₹10 Fee
guidance_steps.description: Pay online via UPI, debit card, or net banking.

guidance_steps.title: Receive CPIO Response
guidance_steps.description: Central Public Information Officer (CPIO) replies within statutory 30-day window.

faqs.q: What can I do if CPIO doesn't reply in 30 days?
faqs.a: You can file an online First Appeal free of charge to the designated First Appellate Authority (FAA).

services.title: Jal Jeevan Mission - Tap Water Connection
services.title_hi: जल जीवन मिशन - हर घर नल से जल
services.department: Department of Drinking Water and Sanitation, Ministry of Jal Shakti
services.benefits: Functional Household Tap Connection (FHTC) delivering potable drinking water of prescribed quality (55 liters per person per day) to every rural household.
services.benefits_hi: हर ग्रामीण घर में 55 लीटर प्रति व्यक्ति प्रतिदिन स्वच्छ पेयजल का नल कनेक्शन।
services.fee: Subsidized / Nominal local gram panchayat charge
services.description: JJM aims to provide piped clean water supply to all rural homes through community-led water and sanitation committees (VWSC).
services.description_hi: ग्रामीण परिवारों को स्वच्छ पेयजल पाइपलाइन से जोड़ने की राष्ट्रीय योजना।

documents.name: Proof of residence / Village house number

guidance_steps.title: Contact Gram Panchayat Water Committee
guidance_steps.description: Register requirement with Village Water and Sanitation Committee (VWSC).

guidance_steps.title: Site Feasibility Inspection
guidance_steps.description: Technical engineer surveys pipe branch connection.

guidance_steps.title: Meter / Tap Installation
guidance_steps.description: Pipeline laid and tap installed with quality test certificate.

faqs.q: Is the water quality tested periodically?
faqs.a: Yes, field testing kits (FTK) are provided to 5 women in every village to test water for chemical/bacteriological contamination.

services.title: CPGRAMS Public Grievance Redressal
services.title_hi: सीपीजीआरएएमएस - केंद्रीय लोक शिकायत निवारण प्रणाली
services.department: Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances (DARPG)
services.benefits: Direct escalation of complaints against central/state government departments with time-bound resolution target of 30 days and senior officer monitoring.
services.benefits_hi: सरकारी विभागों के खिलाफ सीधी शिकायत दर्ज करें और 30 दिनों में समयबद्ध समाधान पाएं।
services.description: CPGRAMS is an online 24x7 platform available for citizens to lodge grievances to public authorities on any subject related to service delivery.
services.description_hi: सरकारी सेवाओं में लापरवाही, देरी या भ्रष्टाचार की ऑनलाइन शिकायत दर्ज करने का आधिकारिक मंच।

documents.name: Complaint description & relevant previous communications / letters

guidance_steps.title: Lodge Grievance
guidance_steps.description: Login to pgportal.gov.in and select ministry/department.

guidance_steps.title: Describe Issue
guidance_steps.description: Detail facts, office visited, officers contacted, and reference numbers.

guidance_steps.title: Tracking Token
guidance_steps.description: Receive unique registration token for SMS tracking.

guidance_steps.title: Action Taken Report
guidance_steps.description: Review official Action Taken Report (ATR) and provide feedback rating.

faqs.q: Can RTI matters or court cases be filed in CPGRAMS?
faqs.a: No, sub-judice matters, RTI queries, and personal family disputes are not entertained.

notifications.title_hi: राष्ट्रीय छात्रवृत्ति पोर्टल आवेदन की अंतिम तिथि निकट है
notifications.message: Pre-Matric and Post-Matric scholarship online applications close on 30th September. Complete your institute verification immediately.
notifications.message_hi: प्री-मैट्रिक और पोस्ट-मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति के ऑनलाइन आवेदन 30 सितंबर को बंद हो रहे हैं।

notifications.title: PM-KISAN 17th Installment Release Date Announced
notifications.title_hi: पीएम-किसान 17वीं किस्त जारी होने की तारीख घोषित
notifications.message: The upcoming installment will be credited via DBT directly into Aadhaar-seeded accounts. Verify that your eKYC status is green.
notifications.message_hi: अगली किस्त सीधे आधार से जुड़े खातों में डीबीटी के जरिए भेजी जाएगी। अपनी ई-केवाईसी जांच लें।

notifications.title: Free Aadhaar Document Revalidation Extended
notifications.title_hi: मुफ्त आधार दस्तावेज नवीनीकरण की अवधि बढ़ाई गई
notifications.message: UIDAI has extended the free online document update facility for Proof of Identity and Address on myAadhaar portal.
notifications.message_hi: यूआईडीएआई ने माय-आधार पोर्टल पर पहचान और पते के दस्तावेज मुफ्त अपडेट करने की अवधि बढ़ा दी है।

grievances.subject: application panding
grievances.admin_response: Grievance received and registered. Assigned to the respective departmental nodal officer for inspection.

grievances.description: Completed biometric eKYC at Connaught Place CSC on 12th Aug, but portal still displays pending verification.
grievances.admin_response: Your ticket has been assigned to the District Agriculture Nodal Officer for re-synchronization with UIDAI gateway.

feedback.comment: Clear document checklist and step-by-step guidance made applying very straightforward!
